contentHtml:
This is a money back guaranteed treatment; if you are not cured we will return your money subject to terms and conditions. Patients will get some relief in the first day itself.  If you are not improving in 3 days time, we will return your money including room rent and food, what else we can do for you?  In 2 or 3 weeks time pain will disappear and you will get full flexibility.  Nerve compression will be relieved. Normally we admit the patients for 3 weeks, rare cases it may take some more time.  You will be free from all signs and symptoms, you can freely walk, run, climb steps, bend forward and backward  etc…  Our treatment is divided into two parts one is panchakarma, which  includes Abhyangam (massage) with specially prepared Ayurvedic oil, Elakizhi, Njavarakizhi, Snehanam, Swedanam (medicated steam), Kati Basti, Lepanam (herbal paste) etc… plus internal and external medication according to the patient’s medical condition.  Normally it takes 3 weeks to cure it. You have to continue the medicines at least for 6 months.

 Our challenging offer

If you are admitted, strictly following our instructions and taking treatment and medicines as directed by us and in any case you are not improving considerably in 3 to 4 weeks time, we will return the treatment charges, including  cost of medicine.  This is subject to terms and conditions.  You have to claim it before leaving the hospital.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Sciatica. We have our own special medicines as well for the treatment of the same. Medicines vary with condition of the patient. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these medicines.

Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will not feel any more severe pain in the first day of our treatment itself.  In most cases they can leave the painkiller in the first day of our treatment itself.   Normally with in 2 or 3 days they will feel much relaxed.
  2. More than 90% people will not feel any more pain within 2-3 weeks time.  Others may take some more time.  The speed of recovery depends on many factors including the severity of the problem, the age of the patient, how long the patient is suffering from this problem etc..
  3. Our medications   will help to remove toxins, inflammation, stiffness, bulging etc..
  4. Once the stiffness and bulging is over, the nerve will be released and you will not feel any more pain. The gap between discs will also be adjusted automatically.  Earlier the stiffness and bulging doesn’t allowed the spinal cord  to keep the discs in the normal way.
  5. Our treatment increase the blood supply in the affected parts and the cells will get more oxygen and nutrients and this helps to rebuild the degenerated discs and stops further degeneration.
  6. In our treatment there is no risky operation or like that.  It is 100% safe and protects your health.
  7.  Our medicines are free from side effects.
  8. Our treatment helps to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.

Duration of the treatment

Normally the patient have to undergo the therapy for three weeks, others may take some more time. Everybody have to continue the medications for at least 6 months. Rare cases the duration may increase.

What is Sciatica?

Sciatica is pain that may be caused by general compression or irritation or discomfort of one of the sciatic nerve. This nerve runs from the lower part of the spinal cord, down back of the leg to the foot. The pain felt in the lower back buttock, or various parts of the leg and foot. There may be numbness, muscular weakness, pains and needless or tingling and difficulty in moving or controlling the leg.  Pain can be severe if prolonged exposure to cold weather
